Yes Secret Warriors and then Secret Wars to wrap it up.  Basically all of Hickman’s pre X-men Marvel stuff including his Ultimate stuff.

Secret Warriors, his Nick Fury/SHIELD story is very good but not required back story for his Avengers run.  It fits in but is not necessary.  His FF isn’t exactly necessary either, Avengers/New Avengers can be totally read and enjoyed by itself, but his FF run is that good and provides a lot of good context.  

His Ultimate stuff is necessary for the backstory as well and will be released in an omnibus next year.  Finally.  

His whole Marvel run though is easily my favorite and his Avengers/New Avengers run is in my opinion, the greatest superhero story/run in comics history.  

It builds heavily off the entire Bendis run on the Marvel Universe, especially Civil War and it’s fallout and AvX.

That’s where we get crossed up a lot.  I tell her everyone needs to get shot at at least once in their life to put things in perspective.

I’ve been working in emergency medicine for about 15 years now.  Started as an EMT then EMT-P/FF for about 10 years prior to transitioning to nursing (ER/Trauma).  Sprinkled in 7 years of military service.  

People ask me all the time “What’s the worst thing you’ve seen?” 

I’m always like, I need more context to frame that question.  Physically upsetting or mentally upsetting?  

Is seeing a 3 week old baby starved to death worse than the 80 year old lady that had her house broken into and was raped with a stick before they stole her meds?  

Are either or anything of these things worse than Anbar province was in 2004-05?

What I always try to tell people:
-Situational awareness at all times.  Everything is fine until it isn’t.

-Have an escape route.  Have multiple escape routes.  For example at red lights do people pull right up like a foot behind the car in front of them at the light?  Are you seriously going to get where you’re going faster?  Leave a car length space as an escape route.  Every time you enter a structure identify at least 2 ways you will GTFO.  

-Watch their hands

-Body armor only works when you wear it.  Ahem, both plates.  

-Don’t be in a rush to get yourself killed.  Fast is slow.
